START_HERE.Specification: Master menu catalog for an AI voice/chat restaurant assistant (SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA).
Urban Tandoor & Grill | PECHS + Gulshan-e-Iqbal | 24/7 operation.
All menu descriptions, prices, alias phrases, recipes status, deals and operating rules are demo assumptions.
MENU001–MENU032 exactly preserve the existing two-branch inventory workbook IDs and item names.
MENU033 onward are catalog-only; no corresponding recipe records or trustworthy inventory capacity.
A row is orderable only if menu status Active + branch status Yes + variant approved + inventory tool verifies stock.
All values are illustrative Pakistani rupees (PKR), excluding taxes/delivery until explicitly configured.
Dietary and allergen hints are not verified. Never provide a definitive allergen-free claim from this workbook.
Imported max portions are an illustrative snapshot of old workbook calculations; NOT live stock.
Standard recipe-linked portions flagged Yes; medium/large/full need portion-specific recipe validation.
Add-ons are definitions only; each needs validated recipe and stock reservation before checkout.
All proposed deals are Draft. Do not advertise as active until amounts, component quantities and rules approved.
Bank 10% discount is documented at project level but eligibility/caps not confirmed; do not apply automatically.
Catalog supports future scheduled orders; prep windows and inventory policy must be established separately.
Excel is reference master-data input; API/DB remain authoritative for real-time orders and ingredient commitments.
Join Menu_Items.Menu_ID to inventory Recipes.Menu_ID and Menu_Availability.Menu_ID.
Complete recipes for MENU033+ and validate add-ons and variants; then activate branch_menu rows.
